picks.title: EPISODE 3: For Heaven's Sake
picks.summary: In Episode 3, Shofar, So Good! host Kate Mishkin delves into havruta learning, the Jewish tradition of studying Torah in pairs. The goal of this paired endeavor: arguing "for the sake of heaven." Kate explores what exactly that means, teaches us about Jewish history's most famous study partners, and learns how AI is changing havruta learning. Then, Kate and her dad become havrutas. picks.title: Why Did Sammy Davis Jr. Become Jewish?
picks.summary:
Sammy Davis Jr. was already one of America's biggest entertainers when he made a choice few expected. He converted to Judaism. His journey began with a car crash that nearly killed him and grew through years of study, faith, and a powerful connection between Black and Jewish history. From the Rat Pack and the civil rights movement to JFK, Nixon, and Israel, Schwab and Yael explore Sammy Davis Jr.'s story in part 2 of a series of Jews in Hollywood, and what it reveals about the search for belonging in America.

Sammy Davis Jr. recorded his hit song I've Gotta Be Me in 1968 for Reprise Records.
picks.reason: Explores Sammy Davis Jr.'s conversion and Jewish identity within historical context.
